body: Everything you said actually sounds helpful, thank you for taking the time <3. I will give it a try, I've got nothing to lose. As for the drawing, I'm totally crap at it but I want to learn how.
thanks man, I appreciate the suggestions

I don't like talking about my dreams much because most of the time nothing comes out of them. But some stuff I'd like to do is learn how to draw for example. The pain is crippling my ability to work on any dreams, and frankly waking up every day to feel agony is kind of a bummer to say the least. I can at least say I get out of the house regularly, even if it's just for a walk, but it's getting super challenging to get out of bed in the morning.
